sc: 'Postie' title scroll is a reward from exchanging 500 postage stamps from the Parcels from the Hedge event.
It was previously obtained by opening a lost property (weighty).
The abyssal slayer contract is a reward from Shattered Worlds, purchased from the Shattered Worlds Reward Shop for 500,000 shattered anima.
Activating the contract provides a random Slayer-style task for monsters found within Shattered Worlds.
A blue Agility tome is an experience reward from the minigame, Temple Trekking.
A yellow Agility tome is an experience reward from the minigame, Temple Trekking.
It is found in the rage room's weapon rack.
Only one anger weapon is obtainable at a time.

Animals' bones (1).x: Animals' bones are items used in the Mage Training Arena Graveyard chamber. This indicates how much fruit will be obtained when the player casts bones to bananas or bones to peaches.

tx: The Apex hide chaps + 5 is created by first making a unfinished apex hide draft at a pattern table, then working on it at a drafting table for 864 progress. It then turns into an unfinished apex hide chaps, which needs 2016 progress at a tailor's dummy to complete.
sc: It is made by upgrading an apex hide chaps with 48 apex leather via the tailoring process, requiring level 100 Crafting.
Arcane Blood Mage Outfit is a cosmetic override outfit that could originally be unlocked by completing tier 1 of Count Yakula's Yak Track.
It could later be purchased for 2,000 oddments from the Marketplace, or for 2,000 H'oddments from the H'oddments Store.
It is obtained from tunnels where players can only enter with an invitation letter.
It is also found at Senntisten Temple.

Assassin Gloves.x: Assassin Gloves is a hands slot cosmetic override. It is part of the Assassin set.

sc: The shadow-dyed augmented sirenic chaps are level 90 Ranged legs slot power armour, created by using an augmentor and divine charges on a sirenic chaps (shadow), or by using shadow dye on an augmented sirenic chaps.

The ice-dyed augmented sirenic hauberk is level 90 Ranged torso slot power armour, created by using an augmentor and divine charges on a sirenic hauberk (ice), or by using ice dye on an augmented sirenic hauberk.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 2 primal bars and a primal warhammer, granting a total of 2,800 Smithing experience.
It can be won on Treasure Hunter during the Cerberus Rush promotion.

s: Accessed via frozen or warped token
sc: The chaotic crossbow frozen dye kit is a cosmetic token reward from the Daemonheim Rewards shop that can be purchased for 500,000 dungeoneering tokens.
The dye kit was previously only available from the Dungeon Delve: Daemonheim Treasure Hunter promotion before being added to the Daemonheim Rewards shop.
The charged engrammeter is a device given to the player by Kharshai during Children of Mah.

Circus (Clown) Leggings.x: The Circus (Clown) Leggings are a legs slot cosmetic override that can be obtained through Balthazar Beauregard's Big Top Bonanza as part of the Circus (Clown) outfit. They are unlocked alongside their item version.

sc: Clean avantoe is a herb obtained by cleaning grimy avantoe at level 48 Herblore, which gives 10 Herblore experience.
Players can obtain a clue scroll from Count Check each day during the events, and may claim clue scrolls from previous days, if they were not obtained.
Clue scroll (medium) is an emote clue obtained from medium sealed clue scrolls.
Raw slimy eels can be caught with a Fishing level of 28 or higher, granting 65 Fishing experience.
The corrupted Ascension signet II is an item dropped by Legio Secundus that can be used to unlock the miniature-boss pet Legio Secundulus.
It is dropped by the Dagannoth Kings and cannot be made by the player.
A decorated woodcutting urn (empty) is an urn created by using an earth rune on a decorated woodcutting urn (no rune), requiring level 76 Crafting.
Dioscuri Shield is a shield cosmetic override that can be purchased for 3 yak coins from the Yak Coin Shop.
It was originally unlocked by completing tier 10 of Zodiyak Track.
It can be obtained at a certain point in the quest by speaking to the Khazard launderer near the Fight Arena by either buying it for 5,000 coins or using an activated ring of Charos.

Duellist's cap (tier 6).x: The duellist's cap is a hat that keeps track of the wearer's number of kills while duelling other players. The tier 6 cap shows that the player has won 5,000 or more duels.

sc: While it is seen on the reward scroll, it cannot actually be obtained by players.

h: As a possible reward from mystery eggs
As a possible reward from lost Easter baskets
As a possible reward from mystery eggs
Via skilling, Rixie's shop, and the cosmetics stall
sc: The Easter egg hat token is a reward that was originally obtainable from the 2018 Spring Fayre.
The egg whisk is a melee kitchen weapon that can be bought from the Culinaromancer's Chest.
Players could only obtain either Eir's helmet or Eir's spear as a drop, but could get more than one, allowing them to trade their spare one with another player to get the other item.
Eir's helmet.x: Eir's helmet was an item exclusive to the winter events from 2014 to 2018. It was given to Eir along with the Eir's spear to claim bonus experience in either Prayer or Divination and to unlock the Valkyrie Spear cosmetic override. It was dropped by the three winter wolves, Hati, Sköll, and Fenrir, or obtained from harvesting an enriched sparkling wisp.

Elf-style boots (blue).x: The blue elf-style boots are part of the elven outfit item set. They give no bonuses and are a cosmetic item.

Elite Mammoth Gauntlets.x: The Elite Mammoth Gauntlets are a hands slot cosmetic override that can be unlocked by purchasing the Elite Mammoth outfit.

h: As a possible reward from lost Easter baskets
As a possible reward from mystery eggs
Via the Advent Calendar (2019) on 16 December
sc: The enchanted bunny egg is an item that could be won from Treasure Hunter.
The egg was made available from Treasure Hunter from 2 April to 7 April 2015.
It is made by combining eternal magic sap with 10 ground mud runes and 10 ground miasma runes, requiring level 90 Crafting and the completion of the Fletch Quest achievement.

r: Partial completion of The Fremennik Trials
sc: It is obtained by giving a pair of sturdy boots to Olaf the Bard in Rellekka.
If it is lost or dropped, another can be obtained from Olaf.
The Guardian's ward is an item dropped by monsters in Daemonheim.
It is only dropped by spiritual guardians.
It can be found in one of the caverns, in the centre of four pots.
The outfit has also been available in the Yak Coin Shop for 6 Yak coins.
An incense burner is a Guthixian artefact that is made by restoring its damaged variant at an archaeologist's workbench.

Initiate cuisse is the platelegs piece of Initiate armour that can be obtained from the Initiate Temple Knight Armoury or Proselyte Temple Knight Armoury run by Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador after completing the Recruitment Drive quest.
It can also be obtained by unpacking an initiate harness (m).
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 4 iron bars, requiring 800 progress to complete, granting a total of 160 Smithing experience.
When dropped by a monster, it will be treated like medium bladed iron salvage by the spring cleaner.
After the quest, the poisoned spear can be bought from Tamayu's Spear Stall and cleaned with a cleaning cloth to get an iron spear.
When dropped by a monster, it will be treated like tiny spiky iron salvage by the spring cleaner.
It is obtained through the Barrows minigame, or by buying it from the Grand Exchange.
When received from the barrows chest, your Adventurer's log used to say that you received a "Karil's crossbow".
However, banking the leaflet and then taking another as well as the drop trick allowed players to obtain multiple leaflets.
Leaflets were discontinued on January of 2012 but still exist in-game for players who had already obtained them.
" Leaflet stands can still be found in-game but can now only be interacted with to examine them.
The legendary call of the sea aura is a tier 5 aura that can be bought from the Solomon's General Store for 119,000 Loyalty Points.
Before a higher tier can be bought, previous tiers must also be bought, so total cost for a specific tier of call of the sea aura is the cumulative cost in the following table.
Liquid honey is a quest item given to the player by Elena during the Biohazard quest.

Lunar legs (green).x: The lunar legs are a piece of Lunar equipment worn in the legwear slot. They can be recoloured into blue, red, or yellow legs or back to their original colour by using them on Diango after purchasing the Lunar Equipment (re-colour) service from Solomon's General Store for 2,000 Loyalty Points or by claiming the Loyalty Point Bundle from the Marketplace.

sc: It is a reward from the Mage Training Arena minigame purchasing from Magic Training Area Shop in exchange for 500 Telekinetic Pizazz points, 550 Alchemist Pizazz points, 6,000 Enchantment Pizazz points, and 500 Graveyard Pizazz points without any Desert achievements discounts.
The ability to recolour this item can be purchased from the Members Loyalty Programme for 6,000 Loyalty Points or by claiming the Loyalty Point Bundle.
They can be made at a forge and anvil using 2 mithril bars and mithril gauntlets + 1, requiring 400 progress to complete, granting a total of 240 Smithing experience.
The monkey mace is one of the five monkey-themed items that were available from the Squeal of Fortune during the third Wild Weekend of Mad May 2012 as an uncommon reward.
It can also be obtained by skilling on The Beach since the release of The Beach (2023).
Moonlight Enchanter shoes is a feet slot cosmetic override that is unlocked through the Academy of Skillers promotion from Treasure Hunter.
A moray & edicap potato is food that can be made and eaten only while training Dungeoneering.
It is made by combining an edicap potato (using a baked cave potato with an edicap mushroom) with a cooked cave moray.

Musketeer's hat (green, male).x: The green musketeer's hat is part of the musketeer outfit item set. It gives no bonuses and is a cosmetic item.

sc: It can be made into 10 Snaring wave (naïve stormbringer) scrolls by using it on a summoning obelisk, giving 0.
The outfit has also been available in the H'oddments Store.

s: Daemonheim starting room and boss room
Daemonheim starting room and boss room
sc: Novite arrows is an item that can only be obtained and used while training Dungeoneering.
It may be picked up from the table at the beginning of a dungeon, obtained as a monster drop, or produced using the Fletching skill.

tx: The oak wood box must be created using oak logs; neither protean logs nor oak pyre logs can be used.

sc: The barrows-dyed off-hand Ascension crossbow is made by dyeing an off-hand Ascension crossbow with Barrows dye.
To obtain this item, players must partake in smithing a ceremonial sword after randomly being given plans when they finish smithing an item in the Artisans' Workshop.
Although only members can smith this sword and it is untradeable, the wield option and the stats are available in free-to-play.
An omni-talisman staff is made by combining an omni-talisman with a runecrafting staff.
Unlike the other talisman staves, the omni-talisman staff cannot be created by the player.
Multiple scales can be obtained, but all are consumed when the challenge is completed.
The pink balloon is created by using pink dye on an origami balloon.
Poorly-cooked bird meat is a food item that can be made by cooking raw bird meat directly on a fire or range.

Robe bottom of the First Necromancer (Blood)
Robe bottom of the First Necromancer (Blood)
u: Augmented Robe bottom of the First Necromancer (Blood)

sc: The Ruby Cane is a weapon that can be won as a reward from the Vault of Riches Treasure Hunter promotion.

Rune armour set + 1 (sk).x: Rune armour set + 1 (sk) is an item obtained by exchanging a set of items with a Grand Exchange clerk via their right-click "Exchange" option, followed by the "Sets" tab and clicking on the appropriate item set within the Item Sets interface.

tx: The rune burial armoured boots require 360 progress to finish.
The rune burial off hand dagger requires 720 progress to finish.

sc: It is a possible reward from completing a hard clue scroll as part of the Treasure Trails Distraction and Diversion.
Heraldic armour cannot be made with the Smithing skill, nor can it be decorated by any players.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 3 rune bars and a rune plateskirt, requiring 1,440 progress to complete, granting a total of 720 Smithing experience.
It is made by using sacred clay (class 4) on a creation kiln in Stealing Creation, requiring level 60 Summoning to make and use.
Shade is a companion pet that was previously unlocked by completing level 90 of Hero Pass: Underworld with the Premier Pass.
It can be redeemed to unlock the Shadow Gem Bow, destroying the token in the process.

Shadowbound Battlemage Robes.x: The Shadowbound Battlemage Robes is a cosmetic override pack that can be purchased from the Marketplace for 700 RuneCoins for free-to-play players and 630 RuneCoins for members.

sc: The signed oak longbow is an item obtained during the Ghosts Ahoy quest.
The drop trick can be used to obtain multiple, as long as the players provide another oak longbow.
The Skullbuster hat is a very rare cosmetic prize that could be won from Squeal of Fortune and Treasure Hunter.
It was also included in the initial inventory of limited rares available from the rare token store.
It is made by using a Summoning pouch on a Summoning obelisk with 12 spirit shards, a gold charm, and raw bird meat in the backpack, requiring 52 Summoning and giving 68.
It can be made into ten Spirit Terrorbird scrolls (Tireless Run) by using it on a summoning obelisk, giving 0.
The starfire chaps are an item that can be bought from the DXP Token Store, the Portable Trader or made by combining 6,000 starlight ore during the promotion period.
It can be made at a forge and anvil using 2 steel bars and a steel square shield, requiring 480 progress to complete, granting a total of 150 Smithing experience.
A strange potato is an ingredient of juju gumbo created by using a juju cooking potion on a baked potato.
Tali's mattock is an item found in the ruined Wendlewick giant camp excavation site, just outside the Hollow Hill grounds in Havenhythe.
It was made by using 2 potatoes, 2 onions and gnome spice with a half baked bowl, then baking it.
Vanquish (ranged) is a two-handed weapon that can be obtained from May's Quest Caravan by allocating 150 quest points to the combat track.

Winter Sports Hat.x: Winter Sports Hat is a recolourable head slot cosmetic override that is part of the Winter Sports Outfit.

sc: Woven top are sold in Keldagrim at Vermundi's Clothes Stall (brown) and Agmundi Quality Clothes (tan and blue).
They can also be bought at the Miscellanian Clothes Shop in Miscellania, although this requires partial completion of Royal Trouble.
In order to reach the gargoyle, the player must have frog spawn in the backpack.
